column1: # bench-baseline.tsv — checked-in latency baseline for Scripts/bench.sh's
# Captured on the M3 Air (the machine PRD §12 latency acceptance is judged
# using the default synthesized clips (short/medium/long, say(1) + afconvert
# to 16 kHz mono WAV) with --repeat 3 (SkylarkBench's default), i.e. each
# number below is the median of 3 decode passes. Recorded 2026-07-31.
# This is a FLOOR the live bench must clear (within Scripts/bench.sh's
# BENCH_TOLERANCE_PCT, default 25%), not an aspirational target — update it
# deliberately (after confirming a slower number is real and expected, e.g. a
# bigger model or a genuinely slower machine), never to silence a regression.
